General children snapshot current state independently; parameter children and owned value continuations share state, and reset replaces parent ownership without invalidating old children.
Existing read marker operations retain order and acquire the .read field; sticky Entity.value_open remains independently owned and checked.

Metadata charge uses both flags and checks before allocation; no default limits, raw-name decoding or namespace validation changes.
